asset_set: Questionnaire Q17 option 1 — Helping refugees settle locally

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: gentle hopeful welcome energy — warm community kindness, never crisis or hardship
forbidden: refugee camp, tents, or border fence imagery
crowds, protest signs, or distress body language

riasec_secondary.use: small leaf-sprout accent on potted plant

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.hair: soft curls in a low bun tied with a ribbon
character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small warm smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — female presentation, warm olive skin, low ribboned bun distinguishes from other slots

pose.stance: full body, standing gently forward at an open doorway threshold
pose.action: extending a house key resting on an open palm with one hand while cradling a woven welcome basket against her hip with the other

top.detail: charcoal collar, lavender ribbed cuff trim

subject.scene_narrative: A young woman stands at a sunlit doorway threshold, extending a brass house key on a lavender ribbon across her open palm while cradling a woven basket of bread and fruit — a doorstep-warm, full-body gesture of welcome and new beginnings, in the same hopeful maker language as the approved Q1 references. The scene stays entirely symbolic: no camps, no distress, no border imagery, just an open door and a gift of belonging.
subject.hero_prop: brass house key threaded on a lavender ribbon, resting on her open palm
supporting_props: woven welcome basket with bread and fruit
small terracotta pot with a single green sprout beside her feet
subject.environment: thin warm doorstep threshold line, faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no building facade or crowd
subject.sensitive_handling: Depict only a hopeful, symbolic full-body welcome gesture — a young woman calmly offering a house key and a basket at a doorstep. Do not depict refugee camps, border fences, distress, crowds, sadness, crying, or any hardship imagery. Face must stay minimal and calmly smiling. Tone must read as warm community welcome, never crisis.

composition.layout: figure centered, slightly right-of-center, both arms open in offering gesture, balanced like 1.2.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + offered key and basket readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter S, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, refugee camp, tents, border fence, crowd of people, distress, crying, sadness, war imagery, weapons, blood, protest signs
